note: Rewritten from the original description by Holmgren (1913) (published as a new form, Mirotermes (Cubitermes) natalensis f. brevior, now Astalotermes brevior following the BSF); the original is in German, measurements in mm. Alate only, soldier unknown; type locality Zululand, Mkosi.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Coloration as in f. obscurus, but smaller. Fontanelle punctiform or slit-like, sunken quite deeply. Measurements: body length with wings 10—10.5 mm, body length without wings 6 mm, forewing 9 mm long and 2.2 mm wide, head length 1.22 mm, head width 1.06 mm, pronotum width 0.94 mm. Soldier unknown; worker the same as in the main species (M. natalensis).
